arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي طَلَبِ الْحَوَائِجِ الى الله تعالى

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مُنْتَهَى مَطْلَبِ الْحَاجَاتِ
phrases.english: 1.O God, O ultimate object of needs!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ عِنْدَه نَيْلُ الطَّلِبَاتِ
phrases.english: 2.O He through whom requests are attained!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يَبِيْعُ نِعَمَهُ بالأثْمَانِ
phrases.english: 3.O He whose favours are not bought by prices!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُكَدِّرُ عَطَايَاهُ بِالامْتِنَانِ
phrases.english: 4.O He who does not muddy His gifts by the imposition of obligations!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُسْتَغْنَى بِهِ وَلاَ يُسْتَغْنَى عَنْهُ
phrases.english: 5.O He along with whom nothing is needed and without whom nothing can be done!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُرْغَبُ إلَيْهِ وَلا يُرْغَبُ عَنْهُ.
phrases.english: 6.O He toward whom desire is ever directed and never turned away!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا تُفنى خَزَآئِنَهُ الْمَسَائِلُ
phrases.english: 7.O He whose treasuries cannot be exhausted by demands!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تُبَدِّلُ حِكْمَتَهُ الْوَسَائِلُ.
phrases.english: 8.O He whose wisdom cannot be altered by any means!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهُ حَوَائِجُ الْمُحْتَاجِينَ
phrases.english: 9.O He from whom the needs of the needy are never cut off!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُعَنِّيهِ دُعَاءُ الدَّاعِينَ
phrases.english: 10.O He who is not distressed by the supplications of the supplicators!

phrases.arabic: تَمَدَّحْتَ بِالْغَنَاءِ  عَنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْغِنَى عَنْهُمْ
phrases.english: 11.You hast lauded Yourself for having no need for Your creatures, and it suits You to have no need for them,

phrases.arabic: وَنَسَبْتَهُمْ إلَى الفَقْرِ وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْفَقْرِ إلَيْكَ.
phrases.english: 12.and You hast attributed to them poverty, and it suits them to be poor toward You.

phrases.arabic: فَمَنْ حَاوَلَ سَدَّ خَلَّتِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
phrases.english: 13.So he who strives to remedy his lack through what is with You

phrases.arabic: وَرَامَ صَرْفَ الْفَقْر عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِكَ فَقَدْ طَلَبَ حَاجَتَهُ
phrases.english: 14.and wishes to turn poverty away from himself through You has sought his need

phrases.arabic: فِي مَظَانِّها وَأَتَى طَلِبَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهَا
phrases.english: 15.in the most likely place and come to his request from the right quarter.

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ تَوَجَّهَ بِحَاجَتِهِ إلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوْ جَعَلَهُ سَبَبَ نُجْحِهَا
phrases.english: 16.But he who turns in his need toward one of Your creatures or assigns the cause of its being granted

phrases.arabic: دُونَكَ فَقَدْ تَعَرَّضَ لِلْحِرْمَانِ
phrases.english: 17.to other than You, has exposed himself to deprivation

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَوْتَ الاِحْسَانِ
phrases.english: 18.and deserves to miss Your beneficence.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَلِي إلَيْكَ حَاجَةٌ قَـدْ قَصَّرَ عَنْهَـا جُهْدِي
phrases.english: 19.O God, I have a need of You: my exertion has fallen short of it

phrases.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ دُونَهَا حِيَلِي
phrases.english: 20.and my stratagems have been cut back before reaching it.

phrases.arabic: وَسَوَّلَتْ لِيْ نَفْسِي رَفْعَهَا إلَى مَنْ يَرْفَعُ حَوَائِجَهُ إلَيْكَ
phrases.english: 21.My soul induced me to present it to him who presents his needs to You

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَسْتَغْنِي فِي طَلِبَاتِهِ عَنْكَ
phrases.english: 22.and can do nothing without You in his requests,

phrases.arabic: وَهِيَ زَلَّةٌ مِنْ زَلَلِ الْخَاطِئِينَ
phrases.english: 23.but this is one the slips of the offenders,

phrases.arabic: وَعَثْرَةٌ مِنْ عَثَراتِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ
phrases.english: 24.one of the stumbles of the sinners!

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ انْتَبَهْتُ بِتَذْكِيرِكَ لِي مِنْ غَفْلَتِي
phrases.english: 25.Then through Your reminding me, I was aroused from my heedlessness,

phrases.arabic: وَنَهَضْتُ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ مِنْ زَلَّتِي
phrases.english: 26.through Your giving success, I stood up from my slip,

phrases.arabic: وَ رَجَعتُ وَنَكَصْتُ بِتَسْـدِيدِكَ عَنْ عَثْـرَتِي
phrases.english: 27.and through Your pointing the way, I returned and withdrew from my stumble.

phrases.arabic: وَقُلْتُ: سُبْحَانَ رَبّي كَيْفَ يَسْأَلُ مُحْتَاجٌ مُحْتَاجـاً
phrases.english: 28.I said: Glory be to my Lord! How can the needy ask from the needy?

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَّى يَرْغَبُ مُعْدِمٌ إلَى مُعْدِم؟
phrases.english: 29.How can the destitute beseech the destitute?

phrases.arabic: فَقَصَدْتُكَ يا إلهِي بِالرَّغْبَةِ
phrases.english: 30.So I went straight to You, my God, in beseeching,

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْفَدْتُ عَلَيْكَ رَجَائِي بِالثِّقَةِ بِكَ
phrases.english: 31.and I sent You my hope with trust in You.

phrases.arabic: وَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كَثِيرَ مَا أَسْأَلُكَ يَسِيرٌ فِي وُجْدِكَ
phrases.english: 32.I came to know that the many I request from You are few before Your wealth,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَّ خَطِيرَ مَا أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ حَقِيرٌ فِيْ وُسْعِكَ
phrases.english: 33.the weighty I ask from You is vile before Your plenty;

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَّ كَرَمَكَ لاَ يَضِيقُ عَنْ سُؤَال أحَد
phrases.english: 34.Your generosity is not constrained by anyone's asking,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَّ يَدَكَ بِالْعَطايا أَعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ يَد.
phrases.english: 35.Your hand is higher in bestowing gifts than every hand!

phrases.arabic: أللَهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاحْمِلْنِي بِكَرَمِكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
phrases.english: 36.O God, so bless Muhammad and His Household, take me through their generosity to Your gratuitous bounty

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَحْمِلْنِي بِعَدْلِكَ عَلَى الاسْتِحْقَاقِ
phrases.english: 37.And take me not through Your justice to what I deserve!

phrases.arabic: فَما أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ رَاغِبِ رَغِبَ إلَيْكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ وَهُوَ يَسْتَحِقُّ الْمَنْعَ
phrases.english: 38.I am not the first beseecher to beseech You and You bestowed upon him while he deserved withholding,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ بِأَوَّلِ سَائِل سَأَلَكَ فَأَفْضَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَسْتَوْجِبُ الْحِرْمَانَ.
phrases.english: 39.nor am I the first to ask from You and You wast bounteous toward him while he merited deprivation.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 40.O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَكُنْ لِدُعَائِي مُجِيباً وَمِنْ نِدائِي قَرِيباً
phrases.english: 41.respond to my supplication, come near my call,

phrases.arabic: وَلِتَضَرُّعِي رَاحِماً وَلِصَوْتِي سَامِعاً
phrases.english: 42.have mercy on my pleading, listen to my voice,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي عَنْكَ وَلا تَبُتَّ سَبَبِي مِنْكَ
phrases.english: 43.cut not short my hope for You, sever not my thread to You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُوَجِّهْنِي فِي حَاجَتيْ هَذِهِ وَغَيْرِهَا إلى سِوَاكَ
phrases.english: 44.turn not my face in this my need, and other needs, away from You,

phrases.arabic: وَتَوَلَّنِي بِنُجْحِ طَلِبَتِي وَقَضاءِ حَاجَتِي
phrases.english: 45.attend for my sake to the fulfillment of my request, the granting of my need,

phrases.arabic: وَنَيْلِ سُؤْلِي قَبْلَ زَوَالِي عَنْ مَوْقِفِي هَذَا
phrases.english: 46.and the attainment of what I have asked before I leave this place

phrases.arabic: بِتَيسِيرِكَ لِيَ الْعَسِيْرَ وَحُسْنِ تَقْدِيرِكَ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ الأُمُورِ.
phrases.english: 47.through Your making easy for me the difficult and Your excellent ordainment for me in all affairs!

phrases.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً دَائِمَةً نَامِيَةً لاَ انْقِطَاعَ لأِبَدِهَا
phrases.english: 48.Bless Muhammad and his Household with a permanent, ever-growing blessing, whose perpetuity has no cutting off

phrases.arabic: وَلا مُنْتَهَى لأِمَدِهَا وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَوْناً لِيْ وَسَبَباً لِنَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِي إنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيْمٌ.
phrases.english: 49.and whose term knows no limit, and make that a help to me and a cause for the granting of my request! You art Boundless, Generous!

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ حَاجَتِي يَا رَبِّ كَذَا وَكَذَا
phrases.english: 50.And of my needs,my Lord, are such and such

phrases.arabic: وَتَذْكُرُ حَاجَتَكَ ثمّ تَسْجُـدُ وَتَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِكَ:
phrases.english: .Your bounty has comforted me and Your beneficence has shown the way,

phrases.arabic: فَضْلُكَ آنَسَنِي وَإحْسَانُكَ دَلَّنِي
phrases.english: .Your bounty has comforted me and Your beneficence has shown the way,

phrases.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَبِمُحَمَّـد وَآلِهِ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهمْ أَنْ لاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً.
phrases.english: .So I ask You by You and by Muhammad and his Household (Your blessings be upon them) that You sendest me not back in disappointment!
